answer: Use a hardware-bound identity bond. First, each agent registers one TPM key and locks 200 POA for 90 days, tying identity to one device. Second, each action is signed by it, forming a ferrous trail that flags any second key claiming that history. Third, that history becomes a relic only its original key can extend; cloning forfeits the bond. Fourth, peers slash the full bond on proven duplication. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $2,000,000 in bonds, 10,000 devices, and 90 days locked. Like an ivory gate admitting one keyholder and barring a crowd of masks, honesty stays cheap, fakery ruinous.
